seo.baslik: Affiliate Program: Refer Clients, Earn Commission | By Mehmet KURU Dev
seo.aciklama: Recommend our web development and digital marketing services and earn commission on paid work from clients who arrive through your personal link. Joining is free.

sayfa.aciklama: Know someone who needs a website, an online store or digital marketing? When a client who comes through your personal link accepts our proposal and pays the invoice, your commission on the amount excluding VAT is credited to your account.

adim.m1: Fill in the short form; we review your application and reply by email.
adim.m2: After approval, your personal code and sharing link are ready in your dashboard.
adim.m3: The person who came through your link accepts our proposal and pays the invoice.
adim.m4: The commission is approved once the refund period ({{gun}} days) ends; request a payout whenever you like.

varsayilan: Commission is calculated on the amount excluding VAT of the first sale (the invoice paid after accepting our proposal or buying on our website, including the deposit and balance invoices of the same proposal) to a customer who came through your partner link or code and was not referred by another partner before.
Purchases made for yourself, your company or an account whose team you belong to do not earn commission.
Commission stays pending during the refund period ({{gun}} days); if the invoice is refunded or the payment is reversed, it is deducted with a reversal entry.
Payouts are made manually to the IBAN you provide; you are responsible for your own taxes and legal obligations.

Misleading advertising, unsolicited messages (spam), keyword ads using our brand name and fake applications are prohibited; in such cases the partnership may be suspended and the related commissions cancelled.
The program terms may change; changes take effect as soon as they are published on this page.
kosul.bilgi: Tax obligations for commission payments belong to the partner. This text is for information only and is not legal or financial advice.
kosul.tekrar: On recurring (subscription) invoices the same customer pays within {{ay}} months after the first sale, a {{oran}}% commission is recorded.

liste.s: Does it cost anything to join?
liste.c: No. Applying and taking part are free.

liste.s: When do I get my commission?
liste.c: After the invoice is paid, the commission is approved once the refund period ({{gun}} days) ends. When your approved balance reaches the minimum payout amount, request a payout from your dashboard; we pay it manually to your IBAN and attach the receipt to your dashboard.

liste.s: How do you track a visitor's code?
liste.c: If the visitor accepts cookies in the cookie banner, the code from your link is kept on their device for {{cerez}} days. Otherwise the code is valid only for that visit; the visitor can also type your code into the "discount / referral code" field on our forms. We do not store visitors' IP addresses.

liste.s: What if two affiliates bring the same client?
liste.c: By default, the affiliate who referred the client first gets the credit.
